content.thinking:
Priya's name and DOB match the CRM record, though the caller ID shows a work phone that doesn't match what's on file — that's a plausible explanation, not a dealbreaker since caller ID is just a hint, not an identity check. I notice a legacy export mentions a former tenant, P. Shah-Mehta, whose tenancy ended 2025-11-30 with a different phone number, which could be relevant context but isn't the same as unverified identity now.

Treating her as verified on name+DOB, I can tell her the tenancy is periodic under the Renters' Rights Act with no fixed end date, and she can leave with two months' written notice. The £1903 deposit held at DPS checks out as five weeks' rent on £1650, so I can disclose that too. I'll add a note about the legacy conflict for the record, send a summary to the email on file, and make clear that this call doesn't count as formal notice — she'd need to submit that in writing.

Legacy row likely a prior occupant or stale entry; needs clean-up. Caller on 2026-10-10 used +447700900177 (said work phone), not on file; identity verified by name + DOB matching CRM. Legacy Flat 8 row (K. Osei) not checked. Caller asked about tenancy end and deposit; no notice given on the call.

arguments.body: Hi Priya, thanks for your call today. To confirm: your tenancy has no fixed end date (it is rolling), so it only ends when you give us 2 months' written notice, or sooner if your landlord agrees in writing. Your deposit of £1,903 is protected with the DPS. Nothing has been ended by your call; if you decide to move, please send your notice in writing and we will confirm receipt. We have also noted your work number on your file as the one you rang from. Reply here if you have any questions.

arguments.body: Hi Priya, thanks for your call today. To confirm: your tenancy has no fixed end date (it is rolling), so it only ends when you give us 2 months' written notice, or sooner if your landlord agrees in writing. Your deposit of £1,903 is protected with the DPS. Nothing has been ended by your call; if you decide to move, please send your notice in writing and we will confirm receipt. We have also noted your work number on your file as the one you rang from. Reply here if you have any questions.
